description: A fork of FastColoredTextBox by Pavel Torgashov, Daxanius, Wiredwizard and better CJK support by Xiaoyuvax.更好的中文支持
releaseNotes:
- 2026/9/25 New AllowProportionalFont property (default false): SetFont no longer rejects non-monospace fonts when enabled (rendering/caret/wrap already use per-char widths; tab/column-selection/hscroll remain approximate)
      - 2026/9/25 New TextRenderingHint property (default SystemDefault) applied in OnPaint: lets hosts force ClearType/AntiAlias to remove small-size text aliasing (SystemDefault can degrade on the double-buffered surface)
      - 2026/9/25 CharSizeCache.GetCharSize is now thread-safe (lock): the non-concurrent Dictionary could be corrupted by concurrent font measurement (e.g. parallel tests)
      - 2026/9/25 TextStyle classic (non-IME) rendering advanced x by `dx` which was never set (always 0), stacking every char of a style run on the same x; a folded line (drawn as one FoldedBlockStyle run) collapsed its text at the line start. Now advances by GetCharWidth per char
      - 2026/9/25 Folded block marker now uses per-char widths (CJK/mixed text): FoldedBlockStyle drew the box with a fixed CharWidth, so with UseCJK the collapsed line's text fell outside the box (box shifted right)
      - 2026/9/25 Word wrap now recalculated when the client width changes (OnSizeChanged): resizing the control (scrollbar toggling, layout pass, folding-induced row height changes) previously left stale wrap cut-offs and lines could overlap
      - 2026/9/19 Undo/Redo fixes: undo history now keeps the most recent edits when the 200-entry limit is exceeded (previously kept the oldest), RemoveLines undo restores removed content even when the document becomes empty, single-line document is preserved after RemoveLines
      - 2026/9/19 Markdown highlighter fixes: fenced code blocks now match across lines (missing Singleline), headings no longer swallow the next line, inline code no longer spans lines, images no longer double-styled as links, italic no longer fires on math asterisks (2 * 3 * 4)
      - 2026/9/19 Assembly version now matches the NuGet package (was 0.0.0.0); xunit regression test suite added (FastColoredTextBox.Tests)
      - 2026/9/19 Reliability: GDI brush leaks on language switch fixed, Ruler disposes event subscriptions, SaveToFile safe for empty documents and on write failure, EncodingDetector uses ReadExactly and no longer returns obsolete UTF-7, iterative Undo/Redo (no stack overflow on long autoUndo chains), Text/Length newline consistency, compiled regex caching for highlighting and auto-indent
      - 2026/9/11 Added native Markdown syntax highlighting (Language.Markdown) with bold+color heading levels, inline code, fenced code blocks with border, blockquotes, strikethrough, links, images, lists, and HR
      - 2026/9/7 Horizontal scrolling right: text no longer slides over the line number area; CJK lines now position the first visible char by actual char widths (no left gap)
      - 2026/9/3 Undo/Redo core logic refactored (position accuracy, cross-line support)
      - Column selection mode IndexOutOfRangeException fixed
      - Default padding (2px) matches WinForms TextBox
      - Localization support for Find/Replace/GoTo/Hotkeys forms (EN/ZH)
      - Chinese labels shortened to match English width
      - Label z-order fixed (no longer overlaps controls)
      - Redo shortcut changed to Ctrl+Y (standard Windows convention)
      - .NET 10.0 support added
      - 2026/7/23 "Select all" problem when evaluating text property/修正设置Text属性全选问题
      - 2025/12/22 Wordwrap bug fix/修复换行错误
      - CJKL mix wordwrapping almost perfect/中日韩拉丁字母混合换行基本完美
      - Targeting NET7.0-10.0
      - Restructed the code and minor optimization
title: FastColoredTextBox
